messages:
Elenia: Quick async — preflight checklist for NovoHealth on‑prem activation. Customer AAT window is next Thurs 20:00 UTC. Who can own networking, cert rotation, and image signing? Listing current blockers and asks below.

Samir: I can own networking. Current network status: tenant subnet 10.4.0.0/16, NAT expected. Need explicit egress to our mirror endpoints + auth/kms. Required ports: 443 (out), 123 (NTP), 22 (jump for debug). Security please confirm if 22 needs to be locked to jump host only.

Chris: Air‑gap bootstrap blocker: signed images not present in registry‑mirror. Waiting on CA/Signing artifacts from Security (Tara). Also need offline cert rotation path in runbook. Example local rotate command:
```
./scripts/rotate-cert --offline --ca /mnt/ca.crt
```

Tara: I have the CA keys ready; uploading today to secure share and will provide the signed chain. @Matthew, can you confirm CR includes the image‑signature metadata?

Matthew: CR is in review. Two things I flagged: 1) rollback plan currently assumes no DB change — if we do any schema touch we need a revert path; 2) gating smoke test needs an explicit KV cache warmup step before traffic cut. ETA addressing comments: EOD today.

ops-bot: [deploy-checker] staging smoke results: 12/12 checks passed. staging-canary=healthy.

Elenia: Thanks — @Samir please add the NAT + mirror hosts to the tenant firewall doc. @Chris please add the offline rotation steps and the smoke command to the runbook. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Samir: Will update the firewall doc now. Adding mirror endpoints: mirror-1.s3.redwood.com, mirror-2.s3.redwood.com, auth.kms.redwood.io. Doc link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/tenant-firewall/novohealth

Chris: Runbook updated: https://go.redwood/runbooks/novodeploy — added rotate script snippet and the canary smoke command:
```
curl -I https://mirror-1.s3.redwood.com/health
```

Tara: CA bundle uploaded to secure share and sent to customer. Notarized chain attached in the share.

Matthew: CR comments addressed and pushed. Can QA run the KV warmup test so I can merge? @Priya

Priya: I can run KV warmup tonight and will report pass/fail by 22:00 UTC.

Elenia: Great — plan: merge CR after Priya confirms, final smoke and then activation Thurs 20:00 UTC. I'll create a short oncall rota for the activation window. If anything else pops up call it out here. Thanks everyone!
